summary:
Implementation plan for Settings overhaul:
1. Multilingual Support: Expand site and subtitle language selections to include English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Italian, and Portuguese with a clean selector modal/dropdown.
2. Settings Cloud Synchronization: Ensure all user preferences automatically sync with Firestore when logged in, and load cloud settings immediately upon sign-in.
3. Settings Auth Gate: Prompt logged-out users to sign in when clicking Settings, and automatically transition them to Settings upon successful authentication.
4. Appearance Section Removal: Completely remove the Appearance section, Theme controls, and Accent Color options from the Settings interface.
